verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of searching or filtering error events across projects by tag, release, environment or custom properties, and no query syntax is described. The only search-related evidence covers log search (filtering logs by level, service, environment, trace ID or text, including via the MCP list_logs tool) and browsing issues. That is an adjacent feature, not the event-search capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and filter events across projects by tag, release, environment, and custom properties with a real query syntax
